Shanice: Here we are!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There are a lot of people here. Maybe it would be a good place to start converting again.
You: What people. I can’t see anyone.
Bot: They stay hidden, but we can notice them because of the heat signatures.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s precisely right. It appears to me that they are quite interested in us.
You: A-are we in danger?
